calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for A1apps
calls.summary: A1 Apps is facing significant challenges with Firebase, taking about 10 days for product experimentation due to manual data analysis and delays, which hampers real-time decision-making. Currently, they run about 10 experiments per month across five apps, each producing around $10,000 daily in revenue, focusing on monetization, retention, and engagement. They are exploring GrowthBook as a more automated and efficient platform, which offers real-time analysis, flexible experiment targeting, and no need for app redeployments. A1 Apps aims to run up to 20 experiments monthly using GrowthBook while requiring a clear pricing proposal before moving forward. The need for accurate and speedy experimentation is underscored by their significant revenue generation.
calls.keywords: remote config, experiment analysis, BigQuery integration, feature flagging, A/B testing, enterprise support
calls.action_items:
**Shrinath Satyarthi**
Provide GrowthBook with exact numbers for experiments per month and team size to enable accurate pricing proposal (36:41)
Review GrowthBook’s pricing proposal and ROI model once received to inform decision making (40:24)
Compile an evaluation document comparing Firebase and GrowthBook using shared materials and meeting transcript for internal reporting (41:03)

**James Shannon**
Send a one-page comparison document between GrowthBook and Firebase to A1apps after the call (17:31)
Prepare and send a detailed pricing proposal including ROI metrics based on A1apps’ experiment volume and user count (40:24)
Schedule a technical demonstration with GrowthBook’s technical team for early next week (37:24)
Arrange a separate call with Shrinath to build a customized ROI model specific to A1apps using their data (39:00)
Provide requested documentation including presentation slides and meeting transcript for A1apps’ internal evaluation and reporting (41:00)
